# Current-policy fork and explicit resync — D-038
With the same parent at revision 7 and the same revocation, a child using `fork_mode: current_policy` resolves revision 8. It drops the revoked-derived grant and retains `g-vp-room-read`. An unauthorized `policy-resync` returns `403 policy_resync_not_granted`, writes no snapshot, and writes a denial audit row. The authorized request uses `expected_policy_rev`, commits one complete revision, and is read back before success.
